name: Discovery of Fire
description: Humans learn to control fire for warmth, cooking, and protection.

name: Invention of Wheel
description: The wheel is invented, revolutionizing transportation and enabling the development of vehicles.

name: Development of Iron Smelting
description: Iron smelting is invented, leading to significant advancements in tools, weapons, and infrastructure.

name: Heliocentric Model of the Solar System
description: Copernicus proposes that the Earth and other planets revolve around the Sun, challenging the geocentric model.

name: Law of Universal Gravitation
description: Isaac Newton formulates the law of universal gravitation, explaining the motion of celestial bodies.

name: Invention of the Steam Engine
description: James Watt invents the improved steam engine, powering the Industrial Revolution.

name: Theory of Evolution
description: Charles Darwin proposes the theory of evolution by natural selection, explaining the origin of species.

name: Discovery of Penicillin
description: Alexander Fleming accidentally discovers the antibiotic properties of Penicillin, revolutionizing medicine.

name: Invention of the Computer
description: The first electronic programmable computer, the ENIAC, is completed.

name: Moon Landing
description: NASA's Apollo 11 mission successfully lands humans on the Moon.

name: Decoding of the Human Genome
description: The Human Genome Project completes the sequencing of the entire human genome.

name: Discovery of Gravitational Waves
description: Scientists detect gravitational waves, confirming a major prediction of Albert Einstein's theory of general relativity.

name: COVID-19 Pandemic
description: The world experiences a global pandemic caused by the novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2.

name: Quantum Supremacy
description: Google's quantum computer achieves quantum supremacy, performing a calculation beyond the capabilities of classical computers.

name: Creation of CRISPR-Cas9
description: Scientists develop the revolutionary gene-editing tool CRISPR-Cas9, allowing precise modifications to DNA.

name: Discovery of Dark Energy
description: Observations indicate the existence of dark energy, a mysterious force accelerating the expansion of the universe.

name: Development of Vaccines
description: Edward Jenner introduces the smallpox vaccine, paving the way for the development of vaccines against various diseases.

name: First Transistor
description: The first working transistor, a key component of modern electronics, is invented.

name: Discovery of X-Rays
description: Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen discovers X-rays, revolutionizing medical imaging.

name: Theory of General Relativity
description: Albert Einstein presents his theory of general relativity, describing gravity as the curvature of spacetime.

name: Discovery of Penicillin's Antibacterial Properties
description: Alexander Fleming observes that Penicillin has antibacterial properties.

name: First Atomic Bomb
description: The Manhattan Project successfully tests the first atomic bomb during World War II.

name: Development of DNA Structure
description: James Watson and Francis Crick propose the double helix structure of DNA, unlocking the secrets of genetic inheritance.

name: Discovery of Relativity
description: Albert Einstein publishes his theory of special relativity, revolutionizing our understanding of space and time.

name: Invention of the Telegraph
description: Samuel Morse invents the telegraph, enabling long-distance communication using electrical signals.

name: Discovery of Nuclear Fusion
description: Scientists achieve controlled nuclear fusion, a potential source of unlimited clean energy.

name: Discovery of Antibiotics
description: Alexander Fleming discovers the antibiotic properties of Penicillin.

name: Development of the Periodic Table
description: Dmitri Mendeleev develops the periodic table, organizing elements based on their properties.

name: Discovery of Neptune
description: Urbain Le Verrier and John Couch Adams independently predict and discover the planet Neptune.

name: Invention of Photography
description: Louis Daguerre and Joseph Nicéphore Niépce invent practical processes for capturing and preserving images.

name: Discovery of Radioactivity
description: Henri Becquerel discovers radioactivity in uranium, leading to groundbreaking research on atomic structure.

name: Invention of the Light Bulb
description: Thomas Edison invents a practical incandescent light bulb, revolutionizing indoor lighting.

name: Development of Quantum Mechanics
description: Max Planck and Albert Einstein contribute to the development of quantum mechanics, providing a new understanding of the behavior of atoms and subatomic particles.

name: Discovery of Electromagnetic Waves
description: James Clerk Maxwell predicts and Heinrich Hertz confirms the existence of electromagnetic waves.

name: Invention of the Printing Press
description: Johannes Gutenberg invents the printing press, revolutionizing the dissemination of knowledge and the spread of information.

name: Invention of the Telephone
description: Alexander Graham Bell invents the telephone, facilitating long-distance communication through voice transmission.

name: Discovery of Cosmic Microwave Background
description: Scientists discover the cosmic microwave background radiation, providing evidence for the Big Bang theory.

name: First Human Heart Transplant
description: Dr. Christiaan Barnard performs the first successful human heart transplant.

name: Discovery of DNA
description: James Watson and Francis Crick discover the structure of DNA, the molecule carrying genetic information.

name: Discovery of Electromagnetic Induction
description: Michael Faraday discovers the principle of electromagnetic induction, leading to the development of generators and electric motors.

name: Invention of the Microscope
description: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek invents the microscope, opening up a new world of microscopic organisms and cells.

name: Discovery of Neptune's Moon Triton
description: William Lassell discovers Neptune's largest moon, Triton.

name: Invention of the Radio
description: Guglielmo Marconi invents the radio, enabling wireless communication over long distances.

name: Discovery of Genetics
description: Gregor Mendel's experiments with pea plants lay the foundation for the science of genetics.

name: Discovery of Neutron
description: James Chadwick discovers the neutron, a subatomic particle with no electrical charge.

name: Invention of the Airplane
description: The Wright brothers, Orville and Wilbur, invent and fly the world's first successful airplane.

name: Theory of Special Relativity
description: Albert Einstein presents his theory of special relativity, introducing the concept of spacetime and challenging Newtonian physics.

name: Invention of the Transistor
description: William Shockley, John Bardeen, and Walter Brattain invent the transistor, starting the electronic revolution.

name: Discovery of the Electron
description: J.J. Thomson discovers the electron, a fundamental subatomic particle.

name: First Cloning of a Mammal
description: Dolly the sheep becomes the first mammal to be cloned from an adult somatic cell.

name: Discovery of the Higgs Boson
description: Scientists at CERN announce the discovery of the Higgs boson, confirming the existence of the Higgs field and explaining the origin of mass.

name: Development of the Theory of Plate Tectonics
description: Scientists propose the theory of plate tectonics, explaining the movement of Earth's lithospheric plates and the formation of continents and ocean basins.
